name: Ricardo Alves
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport was somewhat unconventional, starting with a fascination for mathematics and physics during his youth in São Paulo. Instead of racing himself, he found his passion in the intricacies of vehicle dynamics and data analysis. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering, he spent several years working in the automotive industry, refining his technical skills before finally making the leap to motorsport.

As a performance engineer, Ricardo is meticulous and data-driven. He believes in a systematic approach to problem-solving, focusing on identifying key performance indicators and optimizing them through precise adjustments. While relatively new to the high-pressure environment of professional racing, Ricardo's deep understanding of engineering principles and his unwavering commitment to continuous improvement make him a valuable asset to any team. He's driven to elevate his performance, eager to learn from his colleagues, and contribute to achieving exceptional results.

While Ricardo may not be the most charismatic member of the team, his practical mindset and relentless pursuit of efficiency set him apart. He brings a disciplined focus to every task, ensuring that no detail is overlooked in the quest for performance gains. He's determined to carve out a long and successful career in motorsport, one calculated adjustment at a time.

physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking black coffee from the same chipped mug every morning.
